reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the shipped skill and harness references, harness setup, CLI readiness and domain terms for one change: the CLI uses what a service that offers session_stopped_hold and question_dismiss provides, and does exactly what it did before against one that does not. A conversation stopped by its app or the machine (macOS, Linux) is reported to the service as stopped from the generation that held it and stays in the hub's batched exchange, so notes and post-read Answer Edits sent to it are seen (never claimed) and held by the service; each keeps it, and the hub, waiting for 24 h from when it was sent, within the existing one-answer-window ceiling. An answer held for it is dropped locally when its question's own window ends while the service holds it as stopped (the service shows it not delivered), so it is never handed in later, and the agent owes no acknowledgement for it. When nothing waits any more it is reported ended, so it stops accepting notes. When it comes back, the service refuses the old incarnation's renewal and a new incarnation acquires it (generation + 1); where the service only saw the lease lapse it renews as before. A fork that records its origin (Codex forked_from_id, Claude Code /branch forkedFrom) of a stopped conversation, or of one ending with nowhere left to run, is reported as ended with end_reason continued and the fork as successor when the fork already notified: the service moves its open questions, held answers and pending notes there, and locally the asked questions, held and delivered answers and owed acknowledgements move to the fork's records, whose answer owner collects and hands them in; anything never submitted ends with the old session. If the service refuses the successor it ends as a close, as before. A question the User dismissed (its reply window closed before it was due, with no reply; for a fresh send whose receipt already shows a window well short of the one asked for, measured from when the send started) ends a waiting send --reply after the next poll with exit 3, stdout 'no reply for request <id>; the reply window has closed' and stderr 'No reply: the reply window for <id> has closed, so no answer will come.', and the hub's or detached answer owner retires an ask question as an expiry through the existing close and retirement path, keeping the other questions it waits on. A batch the service refuses while it carries a stopped entry or a continued end makes the hub ask the service again what it offers. harness-codex.md and harness-claude-code.md now say notes sent meanwhile wait too and that a fork or /branch takes the questions with it when it already notified and the service supports it, otherwise they expire; README says the same, adds that an answer still waiting at its window is not delivered and the devices say so, and that a dismissed question ends a send --reply wait or retires an ask question like an expiry. Hook output, generated hook definitions, readiness states, hook.gate reasons, TRUST, the protocol package and domain terms are unchanged.
